wrapper.description: FLUX.3 Klein · Text to image. Three hardware variants inside one portable family. T4 16 GB: INT8 convrot; 11.02 GB first download. Experimental until tested on your instance.
wrapper.readme:
# FLUX.3 Klein · Text to image
## T4 16 GB
Original supplied ComfyUI designer graph. Select Platform variant before initialization. T4, RTX and Apple Silicon graphs are packaged together; each keeps its own immutable hash and dependency pins.
## Connect and initialize
1. Run all cells of the current bundled Colab/Kaggle notebook, or use docs/LOCAL_COMFYUI_TEST.md for a managed local agent. Enable private console/scripts for this recipe. No model commands in Jupyter are needed.
2. Instances: add the printed relay URL and node ID. Enable temporary polling for trycloudflare.com. Select this workflow and Initialize; review the exact model destinations and sizes.
3. This gated model requires accepting its upstream terms at https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy. In the app's private remote terminal run huggingface-cli login (or hf auth login). Cached credentials stay on the node; they are never exported with this package.
4. Initialize downloads the three hash-pinned files, reuses already verified bytes, checks the ComfyUI FLUX.3 loader and creates model folders. It then prepares the API through the utility, publishes the designer workflow and verifies a weight-free canary. No third-party ComfyUI nodes or LoRAs are required.
5. Use Create generation job. Choose an active instance, adjust prompt/size/seed/steps and media, Add to queue, then Run selected in Jobs. Results are shared by Library and Renders.
## Runtime requirements
ComfyUI must include FLUX.3 support, upstream merge 20b46065ef7f34fa21e8abebe8d0cca90a904d6d (PR 17064). Older notebook core pins need a fresh compatible runtime. The recipe checks support and never replaces your ComfyUI checkout or PyTorch installation.
T4 16 GB: supplied baseline only; actual memory/driver support must be tested. T4 INT8 convrot on compute capability 7.5 is experimental; an incompatible kernel must be resolved before running. Apple Silicon uses full BF16 files, requires substantial unified memory and current MPS support. GPU execution is not yet verified by this demo.
## Controls and output
16 steps, CFG 1, Euler/simple, batch one are supplied defaults. Width and height are explicit. Negative conditioning uses ConditioningZeroOut; no separate negative prompt is exposed. SaveImage is the selected output.
## Download budget
11.02 GB of model files, plus cache/staging space. Other hardware variants may share files. Existing matching hashes are reused; conflicting files are never overwritten. No weights are inside the package.

import os,pathlib

PY
